conventions.timezone: All comparisons use civil UTC+8, matching the library Jie tables. No claim that Solar API has arbitrary timezone support.
conventions.sect2MinuteSpan: Library subtractMinute ignores seconds at both endpoints; HHC Jie table rounds its astronomical timestamp to the nearest minute. One minute in this convention maps to two onset hours.
conventions.daYun: Index0 is pre-first-luck period with empty GanZhi. Indices1..9 form actual 10-year luck cycles. Calendar year/age labels are not exact anniversary boundaries.
conventions.unknownBirthHour: Samples demonstrate variation; must present a range/ask time rather than use fabricated noon. These 5 hour samples are illustrative and are not a full-day extrema proof.
